Body.Content:
Business value

Field service organizations often depend on mobile offline so technicians can keep working when connectivity is limited or unavailable. As offline profiles grow larger and apps include more related data, first sync, resource loading, and repeated sync work can affect technician productivity and confidence in the mobile experience.

Power Apps mobile offline is being updated with a more native foundation for data access and sync orchestration. This foundation is intended to improve responsiveness, reduce repeated sync work, and better support complex Field Service Mobile apps that use larger offline profiles and richer related data.

Feature detail

This update modernizes the mobile offline foundation used by Power Apps mobile and Field Service Mobile. It includes native sync processing, improved handling of related rows during first sync, and optimizations for app resource and custom file loading.

The updated foundation is designed to strengthen offline data access and sync orchestration while preserving the mobile offline app experience customers already use. Administrators and makers should continue to review offline profile design, table relationships, data volume, and file usage to align mobile offline configuration with field usage patterns.

GA date: November CY2026
